notes.title: New release: v1.15.0 - Minor changes and bug fixes
notes.notes:
[b]A new version of Magic Research, v.1.15.0, is now released on Steam![/b] This new version has mostly smaller UI changes and bug fixes; no new content.


[h2]Full release notes[/h2]

New features and changes:

- Research menu now shows exp and time needed for next level for each school, as well as their next unlock
- Hide events menu by default on all surfaces less than 1300px wide
- Enchant Lumber Yards will no longer get cast from apprentices if Smarter Apprentices are enabled and the Wood storage is full
- Accessibility: Category headers now instead read as "(category name), Collapsed - Press to Expand" instead of "Expand (category name)"
- Accessibility: Add shortcut Control + Shift + M to announce current Mana and Mana income
- Accessibility: The shortcuts to change the currently open screen can now also be pressed with Control + Shift already pressed

Bug fixes:

- Pressing and holding "Use Time Pieces (Warp)" will no longer consume all Time Pieces
- Mitigate crashes when running game at very high speeds, especially on mobile
- Fix bug where enemies who are stunned for a very long time may cause future encountered enemies not to do anything
- Fix bug where some combat items were usable outside of combat
- Other smaller bug and typo fixes

notes.title: New release: v1.14.1 - Multi-craft, collapsible containers, NG+ balance changes
notes.notes:
[b]A new version of Magic Research, v.1.14.1, is now released on Steam![/b] This new version contains mostly bug fixes, a few smaller UI / UX changes, and balance changes to some pieces of the post-game.


[h2]Full release notes[/h2]

New features and changes:
- Show turned on buildings directly on the button, rather than needing to expand to see this information
- Add the ability to collapse multiple containers across the app
- Add the ability to craft 10 or 100 of an item at once
- Add warning message clarifying the reason why time is stopped and how to solve it if the game has been run on a future time
- Change the message for [spoiler]"Accept the Judgment" after defeating the Evil Headmaster on Temple of Darkness 3F with Darkness, to try to make it clearer that it is not the end of the game[/spoiler]

Bug fixes:

- Fix event overlay window not being scrollable
- Fix secret boss [spoiler]Creator not applying the extra 3x stun resistance duration effect[/spoiler]
- Fix [spoiler]creature message log[/spoiler] not displaying the correct timestamp
- Fix rare bug that could cause crashes on startup
- Fix [spoiler]2nd fight against Master of Evocation[/spoiler] not displaying attack names correctly
- Fix [spoiler]Potion of Augmentation[/spoiler] not correctly giving the same duration to all effects
- Fix certain damage-over-time status effects potentially leading to Exploration recovery never finishing until the damage-over-time effect expires
- Fix bug where incorrect cost was being deducted when buying [spoiler]Strengthens[/spoiler]
- Fix formatting for very large numbers
- Fix some hotkeys not working if caps lock is on
- No longer drop Key to the Dais if there is already one in inventory
- Many text fixes

Balance changes:

- Rebalance post-game boss [spoiler]Alliel to be more resistant to stunlocking (Stun Protection attack duration 30s -> 60s, most "permanent" buffs will cast twice as fast so the boss cannot be stunned out of casting Stun Protection)[/spoiler]
- Rebalance New Game + feature:
  - Add extra boon to [spoiler]Creation: world boon levels 25 and higher begin with all school mastery Storylines unlocked, to make higher difficulty levels more feasible[/spoiler]
  - Modify difficulty multiplier: [spoiler]Enemy dodge +3.5% -> +3.0% / level, to make a level 100/100 run feasible (100 Difficulty has gone from +3020% Dodge to +1821% Dodge)[/spoiler]

notes.title: New release: v1.13.2 - Steam achievements, 2 new Storylines, and more!
notes.notes:
[b]A new version of Magic Research, v1.13.2, is now released on Steam![/b] This new version finally adds 42 [b]Steam Achievements[/b]. In addition, it also adds [b]2 new late-game Storylines[/b], a few new random events, a [b]"Cause of Death" feature[/b] in the exploration log, and more.

Loading up your game should automatically unlock all of the achievements you should have unlocked. 

(If you are playing a NG+, you will need to make the progress again to unlock the achievements - sorry! But you can alternatively export your save, then load the save you had exported before going into NG+, and it should unlock your achievements)

If you notice any bugs, please feel free to let me know in this post or elsewhere. Thank you!

[h2]Full release notes[/h2]

New features and changes:

- 2 new late-game Storylines
- Add "Chest" random events to most dungeons
- Add new "It's raining!" random event
- When losing in combat, the message in the Exploration Log now shows the cause of death
- Add "Pause Exploration" feature while exploring, to give opportunity to prepare before a fight
- Various performance improvements through the app
- Add spells [spoiler]"Time Contraction" and "Apprentice Serenity"[/spoiler] to Exploration spell view
- Add hint on Retirement screen when it is best to keep making progress in Exploration first (i.e. multiplier is high for current progress) or when it is best to retire (i.e. multiplier is too low for current progress)
- (Steam / Web only) Add hotkey to switch between quickbars
- (Steam / Web only) Add hotkeys to switch screens for the most common screens
- (Steam only) Add auto-backups when closing the game and every 15 minutes to AppData/Roaming/magic-research/backups
- (Steam only) Add 42 Steam Achievements

Bug fixes:

- Fix late-game Storyline [spoiler]Challenge (Holy)[/spoiler] not completable in a New Game +
- Remove bottom resource viewer from Exploration screen on very small screens that have no room for it
- (Demo only) Remove 2 unobtainable Storylines from the demo

Balance changes:

- Rebalance formula of item [spoiler]Searing Sword[/spoiler] to be somewhat more balanced in very high New Game + boon values
- Rebalance item [spoiler]Star Wand slightly (+100 -> +125 Mana/sec)[/spoiler]
- Re-rebalance upgrade [spoiler]Massive Warehouses (no longer requires Reinforced Monstruariums; cost 59K -> 25K Monstium)[/spoiler]
- Random event in the Thunder Tower "Struck by Lightning" no longer happens while fighting a boss
- In order to make crafting easier and less annoying, simplify recipe of item [spoiler]Potion of Augmentation (instead of requiring 6 separate potions, require instead large amounts of Water, Monstium, and Fine Dust)[/spoiler]

notes.title: New version: v1.12.1 - "A little less annoying" update
notes.notes:
[b]A new version of Magic Research, v1.12.1, is now available on Steam![/b] This new version is a medium-sized update which tries to mitigate some of the most severe annoyances with the game, making the journey throughout the game more enjoyable. It contains changes that should improve the crafting experience, the Monstium grind, [i]some[/i] annoying boss mechanics, and much more. It also includes 1 new Storyline, 1 new Item and 8 new Upgrades, all related to the theme of the update.

The full list of changes is below, but be warned - there are a lot of spoilers.


[h2]Full release notes[/h2]

New features and changes:

- 1 new late-game Storyline (current total: 97)
- 8 new Upgrades, mostly around the [spoiler]Elemental Dungeons[/spoiler] stage
- 1 new Item: [spoiler]Potion of Augmentation[/spoiler]
- Help messages in the in-game Help screen now persist through retirement when unlocked
- Add a notification badge to Help in the menu when a new message in the in-game help is unlocked
- Add a warning at the top of Campus if all buildings are maxed out but caps can be raised via Upgrades
- Add a warning when retiring if the player appears to be stuck on a boss (if the last dungeon floor that was cleared is the same between the current and the previous retirement)
- Add hint / text on Upgrades screen when all upgrades have been bought
- In late game, [spoiler]after Divine Storyline becomes visible, display divinable Storylines differently from those which cannot yet be divined[/spoiler]
- Increase severity of the warning message on the element selection screen if you choose [spoiler]Darkness[/spoiler]
- Loading save data now grants offline progress (i.e. Time Pieces) from the time the data was saved
- Casting the spell "Getaway", either manually or via Apprentices, now leaves a message in the Exploration Log
- Large screens only: When clearing the game, close all other multi-columns when showing the ending
- Accessibility: Add hidden headings every 10 positions in a list of items in the Inventory or Crafting screens for ease of navigation

Bug fixes:

- Attempt to fix being able to use items even when they cannot be used when the UI is laggy
- Potential fix for occasional bug where unassigning researchers from all schools sometimes did not unassign them from a specific school
- Fix bug on New Game + where old values of the maximum school levels would be carried over, causing items to be visible before meeting their requirements

Balance changes:

Because of the number of balance changes, they are arranged by the problem they attempt to solve.

Crafting is tedious:

- Rebalance Alchemy:
  - Changed most Alchemy potion recipes to no longer require Mana to craft. However, in return, resources (especially Water) and items required have been increased.
  - Increased level requirements for some materials so that they are only feasible to craft before their assumed area if Alchemy is the primary school
- Little Devil now also drops 2 Bat Wings at a 100% chance, and Basement Bat's Bat Wing drop rate has been increased slightly (25% -> 30%)
- Raise drop rates of [spoiler]Mushroom (25% -> 70% for 2) and Death Mushroom (15% -> 25% for 1) from Mushfamily[/spoiler]
- Item now requires different materials to craft: [spoiler]Magic Wool (Instead of 1 Wool and 4800 Mana, it now requires 1 Wool and 1 Silver Bar)[/spoiler]
- Lowered cost but raised level requirement of item [spoiler]Fine Dust (2500 Mana and 60K Stone -> 25K Stone only, Lv28 -> Lv29 Alchemy required)[/spoiler]
- Rebalanced enemy [spoiler]Enchanted Sheep (Max HP 1600 -> 1200, Attack 73 -> 70, Attack Delay 1.5 sec -> 2.0 sec)[/spoiler]

Hunting for random Storylines is tedious:

- Increase trigger rate / chance of certain random Storylines by 33~50%: [spoiler]"The Magic Library", "A Purple Chamber"[/spoiler]

The game is too slow / feels like a grind:

- Rebalance Monstium drop rates:
  - Increase Monstium drops from every enemy in the game by roughly 33%
  - Decrease effect of Storyline [spoiler]"A Purple Chamber" (2x Monstium -> 1.5x Monstium). As a result, Monstium gains for players who have this Storyline will not change, but players who do not have this Storyline will see a 33% gain.[/spoiler]
- Rebalance Storyline [spoiler]"Fairy Circle": now no longer random and requires defeating 250 Fairies across all runs; effect rebalanced (+20% -> +15% Mana regen)[/spoiler]
- Swapped level requirements for spells [spoiler]"Time Contraction" and "Flawless Appearance" (Time Contraction now requires Lv21 Illusion; Flawless Appearance now requires Lv23 Illusion)[/spoiler]
- Rebalance Storylines [spoiler]"Statue (Researcher)" (+50% -> +25% Research), "Statue (Apprentice)" (+2 -> +4 Apprentices) and "Statue (Headmaster)" (+2 -> +5 Mana / sec, +200 -> +500 Max Mana)[/spoiler]
  - Reduction to [spoiler]"Statue (Researcher)" is offseted by new upgrade "Advanced Researcher Focus" which provides an extra multiplicative +20%[/spoiler]

Running out of upgrades:

- Rebalance upgrades, especially between 3rd and 4th dungeons:
[spoiler]
  - Reduce cost of upgrades: ||Affordable Dorms (4000 -> 2500 Monstium), Wool Farm Expansion (17.5K -> 12.5K Monstium), Platinum Currency Storage (18K -> 16K Monstium), Economical Warehouses (16.5K -> 9K)||
  - Increase cost and change requirements of upgrade ||Reinforced Monstruariums (9.6K -> 15K; lock it behind Elemental Dungeons unlocked)||
  - Change cost and requirements of upgrades: ||Hot Generation (25K -> 20K; no longer requires Reinforced Monstruariums), Stage of Wonder (20K -> 16K; no longer requires Reinforced Monstruariums, but now requires Reinforced Vaults), Shared Occupancy Dorms (now requires Reinforced Monstruariums), Dimensional Backpack (now requires Reinforced Monstruariums)||
  - Increase cost of upgrade ||Massive Warehouses (19K -> 59K)||
  - Increase bonus of upgrade ||Physical Training (20 -> 40 HP, 2 -> 4 Attack and Defense)||
[/spoiler]
- With the new upgrades introduced, reduce bonuses obtained from 4th dungeon [spoiler]boss victories (so that the upgrade + the boss clear results in roughly the same stat)[/spoiler]

Using the [spoiler]Darkness[/spoiler] element [spoiler]locks out the ending[/spoiler]:

- Increase penalty of building [spoiler]Mana Cascades (+10% -> +15% Monstium consumption increase per building turned on) to make extremely high amounts of Mana regen harder to achieve, making Darkness spells more valuable[/spoiler]
- Reduce cooldown of spells [spoiler]Dark Wave, Dark Blast, Soul Slicer, and Extinguish Life (2.5, 3.5, 4.5, 5.5 to 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5 sec respectively), to increase Darkness spell potential DPS and make the game easier[/spoiler]

Annoying boss mechanics:

- Remove running away as an enemy mechanic for the following enemies:
  - One of the bosses of the 4th dungeons, [spoiler]Air Dragon (however, its Attack increased 85 -> 95 and base Dodge increased 40% -> 50%)[/spoiler]
  - Storyline boss [spoiler]Master of Illusion, both fights (Fight 1: also increased Attack 100 -> 115 and can now instead cast Slow; Fight 2: also increase Attack 300 -> 350, reduced Attack Delay 1.8 sec -> 1.6 sec, casts Dazzle more often, and can now instead cast Mass Blur)[/spoiler]
- Adjust fight against 3rd boss of 5th dungeon:
[spoiler]
  - Adjust cast time of ability ||"I will not be defeated!" used by the Evil Headmaster (attack delay doubled) to allow for multiple stuns for this attack and an easier battle||
  - The ||Evil Headmaster no longer uses Dispel, and instead uses a new attack "Devil's Venom" (very strong poison)||
[/spoiler]
- Enemy [spoiler]Champion no longer uses "Selective Silence (Protection)" and instead uses "Selective Silence (Dispel)"[/spoiler]

Waiting for Researcher Inspiration is annoying:

- Rebalance effect of random event "Your researchers are inspired!" (effect: +100% Research -> +25% Research, duration: 5 min -> 15 min)
  - To compensate for the extra difficulty in obtaining research [spoiler]if exploiting using this mechanic coupled with "Use Time Pieces (Research)"[/spoiler], add a new +20% Research speed upgrade around the Elemental Dungeons stage

Other:

- Adjust New Game + boons (Research +7.5% -> +12%, Production 2% -> 3%, Storage 15% -> 12%; all per boon level)
- Adjust New Game + difficulty (Enemy Accuracy +3.5% -> +2% per difficulty level)

notes.title: New update: v1.11.1 - New post-game content, New Game+ mode, and more!
notes.notes:
[b]A new version of Magic Research, v1.11.1, is now available on Steam![/b] This is a medium-to-large sized update focused on new content, with [b]2 new post-game Storylines[/b] (which I will not spoil), a New Game+ feature (to be unlocked via one of those Storylines), 1 new Spell, improved tooltip behavior, several balance changes and bug fixes, and more. 

If you notice any bugs, or have feedback, feel free to let me know either here on this post or in the official [url=https://discord.gg/bPhGsaqR9d]Discord[/url].

[h2]Full release notes[/h2]

New features and changes:

- New post-game content, including 2 new Storylines
- Add New Game + feature (to be unlocked behind a Storyline)
- New spell: [spoiler]"Enchant Lumber Yards III" (Requires Enchantment Lv37)[/spoiler]
- Change formatting of favorite spells so they don't extend into multiple lines
- Change versioning check when loading save data to allow loading save data from later patch releases (i.e. 1.11.0 will be able to load saves from 1.11.1, etc.)
- (Steam only) Make the warning about loading demo version save data appear in yellow
- (Steam / Web only) Add a setting to hide tooltips
- (Steam / Web only) Make tooltips mostly not overlap other things in Campus (and similar screens) and in the Spell menu

Bug fixes:

- If Exploration is already open on a pinned column in a multi-column layout, starting a fight from an event no longer changes the main column to Exploration
- Fix caching issue in Options where Conjure Building related option sometimes does not show up
- Fix "Use Time Pieces (Research)" working during [spoiler]the Unscholarly Challenge[/spoiler]
- Fix "A traveling merchant appeared" and "Found a staff!" events appearing large amounts of times while idle, causing almost endless popup chains
- Fix Storyline [spoiler]"Master of Divination" and "Ultimate Divination" not correctly applying the bonus to Bend the Odds[/spoiler]
- Steam / Web only: Attempt to fix sticky tooltips

Balance changes:

- Rebalance late-game Storyline [spoiler]Challenge (Mana) (handicap changed from -50% max Mana and -75% Mana regen to -50% max Mana and variable penalty on Mana regen depending on Mana regen; at 5K Mana regen it will be about -57%, whereas at 50K Mana regen it will be about -86%)[/spoiler]
- Rebalance late-game Storyline [spoiler]Challenge (Unscholarly) (exp gained now slightly varies per school, scaling differently)[/spoiler]
- Rebalance late-game Storyline [spoiler]Challenge (Speedrun) (now enemy stats no longer scale until 1 hour of in-game time, but when they start scaling, the rate is 150% / hour rather than 33% / hour; enemy Accuracy now also scales with the other stats)[/spoiler]
- Slightly lower flee chance of enemy [spoiler]Air Dragon (10% -> 7.5%)[/spoiler]
- Slightly rebalance secret boss [spoiler]Creator (Attack, Defense 700 -> 800, Attack Delay 1.1s -> 0.95s; Big Bang attack delay multiplier 5 -> 5.5)[/spoiler]
- Rebalance spell [spoiler]Dispel Self (Cooldown: 1 sec -> 5 sec)[/spoiler]
- Slightly rebalance Storylines [spoiler]"Master of Divination" and "Ultimate Divination" (per-level effect +1.5% -> +1.25%)[/spoiler]
- Slightly rebalance Storylines [spoiler]"Master of Breeding" and "Ultimate Breeding" (cost scale reduction per level -4% -> -3%)[/spoiler]

notes.title: New update: v1.10.3
notes.notes:
[b]A new version of Magic Research, v1.10.3, is now available on Steam![/b]

This new version contains little in terms of new content, but it contains two important UI changes:

[olist]
[*] v1.10.3 introduces [b]tooltips[/b] to most spells, actions and items, so you can preview what they do or how much they cost by just hovering the mouse over their button.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43760556/692c3b5f41b3bc9b755e411770be06a5e35cb506.png[/img]
[*] This version also introduces a [b]multi-column layout[/b] on wide screens. If the window is wide enough, heart icons will appear next to each menu section. Using these you can pin sections, letting you open multiple simultaneously.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43760556/077807cc7f368c98976d5cb339ef98d487aee542.png[/img]
[/olist]

There are also many balance changes to the late game, and plenty of bugfixes and other UI improvements, such as (hopefully) a fix for the icons not appearing, the possibility to run the game full screen (via Alt + Enter or F11), and many more.

If you notice any bugs in this new version, please feel free to let me know either in this thread or in the official [url=https://discord.gg/bPhGsaqR9d]Discord[/url]. Thank you!

[h2]Full release notes[/h2]

New features and changes:

- Add support for opening multiple screens at once in wide (1900px or higher width) screen layouts
- Speed up auto-press for +/- buttons, as well as Craft button
- Disable "Fight Boss" button while fighting boss
- Allow inventory / crafting item grid to be larger on tall screens
- Add extra hint to gather Wood at the beginning of the game, before building an Apprentice Dorm
- Remove "(1/1)", "(2/2)", etc. display from events when in the most recent page of an event (i.e. not looking at event history)
- Several performance improvements when multiple attacks happen in very quick succession (more than 10 per second)
- Some performance improvements to the Options screen, as well as other minor performance improvements in a few places throughout the game
- Change display of Time Piece consumption on speedup
- Small display only: Add bottom resource viewer to Exploration screen
- Steam / Web only: Add tooltips for collapsed actions, spells and items
- Steam only: Add fullscreen support via hotkey (either F11 or Alt + Enter)

Bug fixes:

- Steam / Web only: Fix icons sometimes not appearing
- Fix combat buffs not clearing correctly when starting a new combat from an event
- Fix auto-press not working on +/- buttons in buildings
- Fix estimated Mana consumption when Smarter Apprentices are off
- Fix Storyline [spoiler]"Apprentice Training" not triggering when player has 15+ apprentices until a dorm is built[/spoiler]
- Fix UI bug in Inventory where items would sometimes get immediately unselected after selecting them
- Fix rounding edge case on cost display
- Fix spell [spoiler]"Magic Artillery" not affecting Nature Evocation spells[/spoiler]
- Fix [spoiler]Bandit Lord not being considered a boss on the Bestiary[/spoiler]
- Fix smarter apprentices not working for [spoiler]"Heal Summon"[/spoiler]
- Fix attack delays of less than the target UUPS not being computed correctly
- Fix building costs flickering quickly under certain circumstances
- Fix spell [spoiler]Foresight auto-casting triggering popups[/spoiler]
- Accessibility (Steam / Web only): Fix heading levels not passing through to screen readers
- Accessibility (Steam only): Attempt to fix alt-tab breaking attack announcements and Shift + Control + Z

Balance changes:

- Rebalance the number of required explorations on [spoiler]Living Forest Depths to unlock Canals (25 -> 15) and the Gold Nugget (25 -> 20)[/spoiler]
- Rebalance bows: [spoiler]Long Bow (Accuracy -30% -> -25%), Bone Bow (Attack 440 -> 450, Accuracy -40% -> -30%)[/spoiler]
- Rebalance some late-game weapons:
  - [spoiler]Divine Blade (Attack +900 -> +999)[/spoiler]
  - [spoiler]Sword of Death (Attack +400 -> +500)[/spoiler]
- Rebalance some gameplay elements to not require Time Pieces:
  - [spoiler]Time Capsules no longer require Time Pieces to be built, and their cost scales much slower[/spoiler]
  - [spoiler]Storyline "Time Capsules" no longer requires Time Pieces to trigger, but it requires primary school to be Lv32 instead of Lv30[/spoiler]
- Rebalance reward of Storyline [spoiler]"The Mimic" (+5 Coins / sec -> +100 Coins / sec)[/spoiler]
- Continue to rebalance late-game:
  - Adjust formula of item [spoiler]"Potion of Extreme Resilience": was 1 / X (where X was 1.67 and was scaled with Mastery) and now is instead 1 / (1 + X) (where X is 0.67 and is scaled with Mastery) as the new X represents the actual bonus better (and is consistent with Speed Potions). At max level and with all Storylines, this results on a decrease of this potion's effectivity from -70.6% to -57.6%[/spoiler]
  - Late-game item [spoiler]"Ultimate Alchemy" no longer decreases Attack Delay; however, base Max HP, Attack and Defense have been increased (+50% -> +75%)[/spoiler]
  - Rebalanced [spoiler]2nd fight against Master of Alchemy to reflect this new effect (Base Attack Delay 2.3s -> 1.9s, Ultimate Alchemy no longer lowers Attack Delay, HP thresholds for potion usage are higher)[/spoiler]
  - Late-game spell [spoiler]"Titan" now decreases Attack Delay at a lower rate (0.5x -> 0.8x) but base duration has been increased (3 sec -> 4 sec)[/spoiler]
  - Rebalanced [spoiler]2nd fight against Master of Enchantment to reflect this new effect (Base Attack Delay 1.8s -> 1.7s, Titan lowers Attack Delay by 20% rather than 50%)[/spoiler]
- Rebalance stunlocks:
  - Stun Protection status effect (both enemies and player) is now granted upon stun, rather than on stun cleared
  - Stun Protection status effect duration is increased by stun's original duration
  - Rebalanced item [spoiler]Belt of Stunning (70% reduction on Stun Protection time -> 90% reduction)[/spoiler]

notes.title: New update: v1.9.1
notes.notes:
[b]A new version of Magic Research, v1.9.1, is now available on Steam![/b]

This is a medium-sized release. It adds two new features, both locked behind two new early-game Storylines, as well as several bugfixes and some quality of life improvements.

This is a small-to-medium-sized release. Most of the changes in this release are various bug fixes, accessibility / screen reader improvements, and balance changes, particularly to the late game.

If you notice any bugs or have any feedback about the new version, feel free to let me know here on this thread or in the official [url=https://discord.gg/bPhGsaqR9d]Discord[/url]. Thank you!

[h3]Full release notes[/h3]

New features and changes:

- 2 new Storylines
- Adds Bestiary feature (to be unlocked via Storyline)
- Adds smarter apprentices feature (to be unlocked via Storyline)
- 1 new late-game Upgrade
- Enemy temporary effects now show up as buffs first, and then debuffs
- Add alternating colors to rows in Apprentices, Research, and [spoiler]||Creatures||[/spoiler] screens
- Rename "Target FPS" to "Target UUPS (UI Updates Per Second)"
- Add ability to clear / remove Apprentice loadouts
- Raise Apprentice loadout slots to 8
- Steam only: Add UI scaling feature to Options
- Accessibility: Add three more headings in Exploration for ease of navigation

Bug fixes:

- Fix sort order of items when no filter is applied to Crafting screen
- Fix display of Memory Chamber in retirement screen on the run it is unlocked
- Fix "(Untracked)" stats displaying when they shouldn't
- If an edge case is found where it is trying to save data that has less total time played than the currently saved data, except for the case of specifically importing save data, crash the application so it doesn't mislead the player into thinking the game is saving the data
- Fix completing Storyline [spoiler]||"The Giant Generator (Cog)" not correctly refreshing storage limits||[/spoiler]
- Fix negative resource incomes not getting correctly formatted
- Fix spell [spoiler]||Divine Magical Knowledge potentially giving experience on schools that have not been unlocked||[/spoiler]
- Try to fix some crashes related to the gesture handling library
- Try to fix some caching issues with Conjure Building
- Exploration tab no longer closes when navigating in and out of the screen
- Fix Storyline [spoiler]||"Miniature Replica" requirements not being the same as mentioned in the description||[/spoiler]
- (Demo only) Adding items "Reinforced Iron Mail" and "Full Plate" which were intended to be in the Demo but were not
- (Steam only) Attempt at warning when hypothetical automatic save data import from Demo version doesn't work
- (Steam only) Fix bug where game processing is throttled when window is minimized, causing Time Pieces to be inconsistently granted instead of the game playing
- (Steam only) Attempt at working around "Module not found" error when loading the game
- (Steam / Web only) Accessibility: Fix checkbox state not readable by screen readers

Balance changes:

- Change duration of late-game spells [spoiler]||Titan and Mass Blur (5 sec -> 3 sec)||[/spoiler]
- Rebalance late-game building [spoiler]||Mana Cascades: 30 Mana / sec -> 25 Mana / sec||[/spoiler]
- Late-game status effect [spoiler]||"Selective Silence" no longer silences spell "Dispel Self" in all cases||[/spoiler]
- Late-game enemy [spoiler]||"Trickster" now casts "Selective Silence (Protection)" if player does not have this debuff||[/spoiler]

notes.title: Welcome to Magic Research! - FAQ & Release Date

[h1]Welcome to Magic Research![/h1]

In Magic Research, you are the headmaster of a newly-created magical institution with one goal: to win the prestigious Tournament of Magic. What challenges, mysteries and adventures await you?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43760556/21920973b5793eb7953a2a617de370dbce8919c0.png[/img]

[b]Magic Research is releasing on Steam on March 23rd, 2023, at 1:00 AM UTC (GMT)![/b] Get ready for the full game by playing [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2342420/Magic_Research_Demo/]the free demo available now on Steam[/url]. Your progress in the demo will be transferred to the full game!

[h2]FAQ[/h2]

[h3]What is Magic Research?[/h3]

[i]Magic Research[/i] is an incremental, text-based game about magic with a concrete ending, a light story, over a hundred spells, more than seven dozen side Storylines with permanent bonuses, strategic depth, and tons of secrets and features to discover - and of course, [b]no ads or microtransactions![/b] If this sounds like something that may be interesting to you, the free demo is a great place to start! By the end of the demo you should have a clear idea if the game is something you might like or not, and since the progress is transferred to the full game, you can continue right where you left off if you decide to purchase.

[h3]What are Magic Research's design principles?[/h3]

I started building Magic Research after having experienced several incremental / idle games and getting a burst of inspiration: I wanted to play an incremental game based upon the idea of casting spells, where the main progression revolved around unlocking more and more spells with powerful and creative effects. As I continued working on Magic Research, I tried to take some of the elements of those games that I enjoyed the most, while at the same time attempting to avoid their pitfalls. As a result, I tried my best to design the game around these concepts:

[list]
[*] A constant sense of progression, where new content and unlocks happen periodically - there should never be a lapse of time too long where there isn't something new going on.
[*] Do not build a game that requires idling in order to make any meaningful progress. Base it around active play, and instead reward idling in a limited manner.
[*] Capture the joy of discovery - keep the player wanting to continue playing in order to discover new spells, things, features. At the same time, make those new discoveries have a clear, decisive, strong impact on how the game plays.
[*] Have a sense of ultimate goal and an ending. Unlike many idle and incremental games, I wanted to have a game with a concrete ending, and this ending should be achievable without extreme, months- or years-long playtimes.
[*] Create the possibility of synergies to be able to quickly or effectively make progress through the game. But do not make the game so difficult that they are required.
[*] Focus on making a good and enjoyable game and do not build in freemium or ads into the game.
[/list]

Magic Research is more of an active game than many other games in the genre. While it does play itself and you can make some idle progress, expect to make progression primarily by engaging with the game.

[h3]How much more content is there in the full game as compared to the free demo?[/h3]

The free demo contains content up to about school level 13~15, which is about 4 to 6 hours of content, and about 18 Storylines. The full game contains 92 Storylines as of the time of writing, content up to about school level 50, and around 40 hours or more of [i]active[/i] gameplay, including multiple features and twists not present in the demo.

[h3]What is the difference between the Steam and the mobile versions?[/h3]

In terms of content, there is no difference at all. The Steam version has a few UI features that the phone version does not, such as: taking better advantage of screen space to display most menus at once, or having keyboard hotkeys for doing certain specific actions.

[h3]What is the difference between the Steam and the web version?[/h3]

The web version is only a free demo and contains the same content as the free demo you can find on Steam. The UI is also essentially the same between the Steam and web versions.

[h3]Can I transfer my progress from the mobile or web version to the Steam version, and back?[/h3]

You can use the functionality in all versions of the game to export and import saves to manually transfer your progress. There is no shared cloud storage between platforms as of right now, so you will need to do this every time you switch devices if you'd like to play the same saved data across multiple devices. If you started the game on mobile but would rather continue on Steam only, though, you would only need to transfer the data once, from mobile -> PC, which should be supported and reasonably easy.

[h3]Is there support for Mac and Linux on Steam?[/h3]

As of the writing of this post, there is no support. It is planned and something I'd like to set up, and something that seems like it should be possible, but I don't yet have a working proof of concept, so it might take a little while.

[h3]Will there be additional content coming out in the future?[/h3]

Magic Research is a complete game. The main story progression is done, and there are no plans to expand upon it as of this date, except by a very small amount of post-game content. That said, I believe it is a meaningful, complete package with over 40 hours of [i]active[/i] gameplay. Most people who have completed the game have done so in somewhere between 10 days and 1 month.

[h3]Where else can I discuss the game?[/h3]

There is an official [url=https://discord.gg/bPhGsaqR9d]Discord[/url] community with moderate activity, the Steam community hub for the game which is just getting started, as well as other unofficial subreddits with discussion on the game.

[h3]Is there support for the blind and visually impaired?[/h3]

As of the time of writing, there is some support, but the game is not fully optimized for this purpose yet. If you use a screen reader, my suggestion is that you play through the entire free demo first before purchasing the game. The full game will have the same UI experience as the free demo, and if you manage to complete the demo you might be able to play the full game. I am slowly adding and improving support for screen readers, so if you find things are not working, I'd love to get your feedback - either in Discord, in the Steam Community Hub, or by email to [url=mailto:magic.research.game@gmail.com]magic.research.game@gmail.com[/url].
